frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Communication, contacts et messages
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Developper les contacts obligatoires, precontacts, conversations et droits de visibilite lies aux contacts.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Activity-created precontacts can be seeded in tests until content/community phases exist.

frontTests.item: Student sees mandatory contacts and cannot remove them.
Removing a contact closes the conversation.
Message send supports text and small attachment error state.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Check upload/body-size limits for light files.

definitionOfDone.item: Users can communicate with role-appropriate contacts.
Precontact lifecycle is visible and testable.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
